what.text: This page follows refugees from Côte d'Ivoire living in Ghana, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 684 Ivorian refugees in Ghana, 2.1% of all refugees from Côte d'Ivoire.
France hosts the most Ivorian refugees, followed by Italy, Germany and Liberia.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Ivory Coast from 2002 to 2004 and in 2011.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2012 to 2021, begin just after the 2011 conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2004 at 10 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 10807, at the end of 2015, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Ghana.
These are year-end totals for Ghana only, reported to UNHCR.
